# IBenjiArkErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/arks/IBenjiArkErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IBenjiArkErrors

Custom errors for `BenjiArk`


## Errors
### InvalidSwapPoolAddress
Reverts when `whitelistSwapPool` is given the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidSwapPoolAddress();
```

### InvalidShareTokenAddress
Reverts when the constructor is given a zero iBENJI share-token address.


```solidity
error InvalidShareTokenAddress();
```

### MustRequireKeeperData
Reverts when the constructor is given `ArkParams` with `requiresKeeperData` unset.
The keeper must supply the SwapPool address via `boardData`/`disembarkData`, so the
flag is mandatory for this Ark.


```solidity
error MustRequireKeeperData();
```

### InvalidSwapPoolData
Reverts when `boardData`/`disembarkData` is not exactly one ABI-encoded address.


```solidity
error InvalidSwapPoolData();
```

### SwapPoolNotWhitelisted
Reverts when the keeper-supplied SwapPool is not on the curator whitelist.


```solidity
error SwapPoolNotWhitelisted(address swapPool);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swapPool`|`address`|The SwapPool address supplied via `boardData`/`disembarkData`|

### SwapPoolTokenUnsupported
Reverts in `whitelistSwapPool` when the asset or iBENJI is flagged unsupported on
the pool being whitelisted (all swaps involving it would revert).


```solidity
error SwapPoolTokenUnsupported(address token);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The token flagged unsupported on the pool|

### ArkNotAuthorized
Reverts in `_board` when this Ark is not an authorized SwapPool trader for the
asset/iBENJI pair (so the swap would revert and strand the asset).


```solidity
error ArkNotAuthorized();
```

### PairNotAuthorized
Reverts in `whitelistSwapPool` when the configured asset/iBENJI pair is not
authorized on the pool being whitelisted (so the Ark could never board or disembark
through it). Pair authorization is a pool-wide setting independent of this Ark's
per-trader authorization.


```solidity
error PairNotAuthorized();
```

### SharesNotReceived
Reverts in `_board` when the iBENJI received from the SwapPool is below the 1:1
expectation minus `depositSlippage`.


```solidity
error SharesNotReceived(uint256 expectedShares, uint256 receivedShares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`expectedShares`|`uint256`|1:1 decimal-normalized shares for the deposited amount|
|`receivedShares`|`uint256`|iBENJI balance delta actually delivered by the SwapPool|

### InsufficientAssetsReceived
Reverts in `_disembark` when the base asset received from the SwapPool is below the
requested amount (the 1:1 redemption underdelivered).


```solidity
error InsufficientAssetsReceived(uint256 requestedAssets, uint256 receivedAssets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestedAssets`|`uint256`|The asset amount the keeper asked to free|
|`receivedAssets`|`uint256`|The base-asset balance delta delivered by the SwapPool|
